{{Quote|You need a hundred gold peggats if you're going to buy a T-14 from me!|[[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|audio=100GoldPeggats.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
[[File:Ep1Peggats.png|thumb|right|300px|Peggats were a currency.]]
The '''peggat''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Huttese]] [[Currency/Legends|currency]] made of [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] on Hutt-dominated [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], a single peggat's worth fluctuated near forty standard [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. A peggat was equal to sixty-four [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]], or four [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]].<ref name="SOT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]] wagered five million peggats<ref name="DBquad">{{DB|character|benquadinaros|Quadinaros, Ben}}</ref>&mdash;about 200,000,000 credits<ref name="SOT" />&mdash;that his colleague [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] would never dare enter the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Quadinaros did, however, and while he failed to make it off the starting grid due to the explosive failure of his podracer's power coupling, he still had met the conditions of the bet. Quadinaros thus pocketed the promised sum, which made him a rich [[Toong/Legends|Toong]].<ref name="DBquad" />

Peggats remained in use on Tatooine long after the fall of the Republic and the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It still had legal tender and was still in circulation after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which saw the Empire's defeat and its replacement by a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Quenton]] placed a bid for the auctioned painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]'' using peggats, since he did not recognize New Republic credits.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The model for peggat piles in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|Star Wars: Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] used images of the [[Wikipedia:Aureus|''aureus'']] coin of [[Wikipedia:Roman Empire|Roman emperor]] [[Wikipedia:Nero|Nero]].<ref name="EP1 game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|Star Wars: Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>
